question: How many indicators were included in National Multidimensional Poverty Index 2021 of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2021 of India is based on **12 indicators**.
 
• These indicators are grouped under three dimensions: **Health, Education, and Standard of Living**.
 
• The MPI report is prepared by **NITI Aayog** in collaboration with Oxford Poverty and Human Development Initiative (OPHI) and United Nations Development Programme (UNDP).
 
• Indicators include nutrition, child mortality, years of schooling, school attendance, cooking fuel, sanitation, drinking water, electricity, housing, assets, and others.
 
• The MPI aims to provide a comprehensive measure of poverty beyond income-based metrics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)**

 
 
• It is a measure developed by OPHI and UNDP to capture multidimensional aspects of poverty.
 
• MPI complements income-based poverty measures by assessing deprivations across multiple dimensions like health, education, and living standards.
 
• It uses household-level data to analyze poverty trends and identify areas requiring policy intervention.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**
 
 
• It is the policy think tank of the Government of India, established in 2015 to replace the Planning Commission.
 
• NITI Aayog is responsible for promoting cooperative federalism and providing strategic and technical advice to states and central governments.
 
 
 
• **Key Dimensions of MPI in India**
 
 
• **Health:** Includes indicators like nutrition and child mortality.
 
• **Education:** Covers years of schooling and school attendance.
 
• **Living Standards:** Includes indicators like access to electricity, sanitation, drinking water, housing, cooking fuel, and assets.
 
 
 
• **Global MPI**
 
 
• The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index is published annually by OPHI and UNDP.
 
• It covers more than 100 countries and provides global insights into poverty trends.
